SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT state.id FROM whatsapp_group_member_state state WHERE LOWER(TRIM(state.group_jid)) NOT LIKE '%@g.us' OR ( LOWER(TRIM(state.participant_jid)) NOT LIKE '%@s.whatsapp.net' AND LOWER(TRIM(state.participant_jid)) NOT LIKE '%@lid' )
UNION ALL
SELECT snapshot.id FROM whatsapp_group_member_snapshot snapshot WHERE LOWER(TRIM(snapshot.group_jid)) NOT LIKE '%@g.us' OR ( LOWER(TRIM(snapshot.participant_jid)) NOT LIKE '%@s.whatsapp.net' AND LOWER(TRIM(snapshot.participant_jid)) NOT LIKE '%@lid' )
UNION ALL
SELECT join_fact.id FROM whatsapp_group_member_join_fact join_fact WHERE LOWER(TRIM(join_fact.group_jid)) NOT LIKE '%@g.us' OR ( LOWER(TRIM(join_fact.participant_jid)) NOT LIKE '%@s.whatsapp.net' AND LOWER(TRIM(join_fact.participant_jid)) NOT LIKE '%@lid' )
UNION ALL
SELECT exit_fact.id FROM whatsapp_group_departed_member exit_fact WHERE LOWER(TRIM(exit_fact.group_jid)) NOT LIKE '%@g.us' OR ( LOWER(TRIM(exit_fact.participant_jid)) NOT LIKE '%@s.whatsapp.net' AND LOWER(TRIM(exit_fact.participant_jid)) NOT LIKE '%@lid' )

SELECT preview.id FROM group_link_preview preview WHERE preview.owner_phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(preview.owner_phone) <> '' AND ( LOWER(TRIM(preview.group_jid)) NOT LIKE '%@g.us' OR NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(preview.owner_phone, '[^0-9]', ''), '') IS NULL ) ) participant_conflict

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT membership.id FROM account_group_membership membership LEFT JOIN account account ON account.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND account.id = membership.account_id LEFT JOIN group_link source_link ON source_link.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND source_link.id = membership.group_link_id LEFT JOIN group_link_preview source_preview ON source_preview.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND source_preview.group_link_id = membership.group_link_id AND LOWER(TRIM(source_preview.group_jid)) = LOWER(TRIM(membership.group_jid)) WHERE membership.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( account.id IS NULL OR ( account.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( source_link.id IS NULL OR source_preview.id IS NULL OR TRIM(account.ws_phone) NOT REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' ) ) )
UNION ALL
SELECT account.id FROM account account LEFT JOIN account_group_baseline baseline ON baseline.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND baseline.account_id = account.id WHERE account.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( account.group_baseline_state NOT IN (1, 2, 3) OR ( account.group_baseline_state = 2 AND ( baseline.id IS NULL OR JSON_TYPE(baseline.baseline_group_jids) <> 'ARRAY' OR ( JSON_LENGTH(baseline.baseline_group_jids) = 0 AND ( baseline.last_group_sync_requested_at IS NOT NULL OR baseline.captured_at = baseline.created_at ) ) OR baseline.group_count <> JSON_LENGTH(baseline.baseline_group_jids) OR baseline.captured_at IS NULL OR baseline.captured_at < 0 OR TRIM(account.ws_phone) NOT REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' ) ) OR ( account.group_baseline_state IN (1, 3) AND baseline.id IS NOT NULL AND JSON_LENGTH(baseline.baseline_group_jids) > 0 ) )
UNION ALL
SELECT baseline_group.account_id FROM ( SELECT account.tenant_id, account.id AS account_id, LOWER(TRIM(group_row.group_jid)) AS group_jid FROM account account INNER JOIN account_group_baseline baseline ON baseline.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND baseline.account_id = account.id INNER JOIN JSON_TABLE( baseline.baseline_group_jids, '$[*]' COLUMNS (group_jid VARCHAR(128) PATH '$') ) group_row WHERE account.deleted_at IS NULL AND account.group_baseline_state = 2 AND JSON_TYPE(baseline.baseline_group_jids) = 'ARRAY' ) baseline_group LEFT JOIN group_link_preview source_preview ON source_preview.tenant_id = baseline_group.tenant_id AND LOWER(TRIM(source_preview.group_jid)) = baseline_group.group_jid LEFT JOIN group_link source_link ON source_link.tenant_id = source_preview.tenant_id AND source_link.id = source_preview.group_link_id WHERE baseline_group.group_jid NOT LIKE '%@g.us' OR source_link.id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT duplicate_baseline.account_id FROM ( SELECT account.tenant_id, account.id AS account_id, LOWER(TRIM(group_row.group_jid)) AS group_jid FROM account account INNER JOIN account_group_baseline baseline ON baseline.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND baseline.account_id = account.id INNER JOIN JSON_TABLE( baseline.baseline_group_jids, '$[*]' COLUMNS (group_jid VARCHAR(128) PATH '$') ) group_row WHERE account.deleted_at IS NULL AND account.group_baseline_state = 2 AND JSON_TYPE(baseline.baseline_group_jids) = 'ARRAY' GROUP BY account.tenant_id, account.id, LOWER(TRIM(group_row.group_jid)) HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicate_baseline
UNION ALL
SELECT binding.id FROM wa_account_group_binding binding WHERE binding.was_in_initial_baseline = 1 AND binding.first_post_control_observed_at IS NOT NULL ) binding_conflict
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wa_group ( tenant_id, group_jid, folder_id, display_name, avatar_url, remark, origin, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at ) SELECT preview.tenant_id, LOWER(TRIM(preview.group_jid)) AS group_jid, link.folder_id, NULLIF(TRIM(link.group_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(preview.avatar_url), ''), link.remark, link.origin, LEAST(link.created_at, preview.created_at), GREATEST(link.updated_at, preview.updated_at), link.deleted_at FROM group_link_preview preview INNER JOIN group_link link ON preview.tenant_id = link.tenant_id AND preview.group_link_id = link.id LEFT JOIN wa_group target ON target.tenant_id = preview.tenant_id AND target.group_jid = LOWER(TRIM(preview.group_jid)) WHERE preview.group_jid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(preview.group_jid) <> '' AND LOWER(TRIM(preview.group_jid)) LIKE '%@g.us' AND ( target.id IS NULL OR ( GREATEST(link.updated_at, preview.updated_at) >= target.updated_at AND ( NOT (target.folder_id <=> link.folder_id) OR ( NOT (target.display_name <=> NULLIF(TRIM(link.group_name), '')) ) OR ( NULLIF(TRIM(preview.avatar_url), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT (target.avatar_url <=> NULLIF(TRIM(preview.avatar_url), '')) ) OR NOT (target.remark <=> link.remark) OR NOT (target.deleted_at <=> link.deleted_at) ) ) OR target.created_at > LEAST(link.created_at, preview.created_at) ) ORDER BY preview.tenant_id ASC, group_jid ASC LIMIT #{limit} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE folder_id = CASE WHEN VALUES(updated_at) >= wa_group.updated_at OR VALUES(created_at) < wa_group.created_at THEN VALUES(folder_id) ELSE wa_group.folder_id END, display_name = CASE WHEN VALUES(updated_at) >= wa_group.updated_at OR VALUES(created_at) < wa_group.created_at THEN VALUES(display_name) ELSE wa_group.display_name END, avatar_url = CASE WHEN VALUES(updated_at) >= wa_group.updated_at OR VALUES(created_at) < wa_group.created_at THEN COALESCE(VALUES(avatar_url), wa_group.avatar_url) ELSE wa_group.avatar_url END, remark = CASE WHEN VALUES(updated_at) >= wa_group.updated_at OR VALUES(created_at) < wa_group.created_at THEN VALUES(remark) ELSE wa_group.remark END, deleted_at = CASE WHEN VALUES(updated_at) >= wa_group.updated_at OR VALUES(created_at) < wa_group.created_at THEN VALUES(deleted_at) ELSE wa_group.deleted_at END, origin = CASE WHEN VALUES(created_at) < wa_group.created_at THEN VALUES(origin) ELSE wa_group.origin END, created_at = LEAST(wa_group.created_at, VALUES(created_at)), updated_at = GREATEST(wa_group.updated_at, VALUES(updated_at))

INSERT INTO wa_group_profile ( tenant_id, group_id, subject, description, member_count, checked_member_count, wa_created_at, announce_only, admin_only_edit_info, member_add_mode, join_approval_mode, ephemeral_duration_seconds, metadata_observed_at, health_status, banned, last_checked_at, last_error_code, failure_count, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT source.tenant_id, source.group_id, source.subject, source.description, source.member_count, source.checked_member_count, source.wa_created_at, source.announce_only, source.admin_only_edit_info, source.member_add_mode, source.join_approval_mode, source.ephemeral_duration_seconds, source.metadata_observed_at, source.health_status, source.banned, source.last_checked_at, source.last_error_code, source.failure_count, source.created_at, source.updated_at FROM ( SELECT preview.tenant_id, resolved_group.id AS group_id, NULLIF(TRIM(preview.wa_subject), '') AS subject, preview.wa_description AS description, preview.member_size AS member_count, health.current_count AS checked_member_count, CASE WHEN preview.group_created_at > 0 THEN preview.group_created_at * 1000 ELSE NULL END AS wa_created_at, preview.announce_only, preview.admin_only_edit_info, preview.member_add_mode, preview.join_approval_mode, preview.ephemeral_duration_seconds, COALESCE(preview.metadata_observed_at, preview.last_preview_at) AS metadata_observed_at, health.health_status, health.is_banned AS banned, health.last_check_at AS last_checked_at, LEFT(health.last_health_error, 64) AS last_error_code, COALESCE(health.health_failure_count, 0) AS failure_count, preview.created_at, GREATEST( preview.updated_at, COALESCE(health.updated_at, preview.updated_at) ) AS updated_at FROM group_link_preview preview INNER JOIN group_link link ON preview.tenant_id = link.tenant_id AND preview.group_link_id = link.id INNER JOIN wa_group resolved_group ON resolved_group.tenant_id = preview.tenant_id AND resolved_group.group_jid = LOWER(TRIM(preview.group_jid)) LEFT JOIN group_link_health health ON health.tenant_id = preview.tenant_id AND health.group_link_id = preview.group_link_id ) source LEFT JOIN wa_group_profile target ON target.tenant_id = source.tenant_id AND target.group_id = source.group_id WHERE target.id IS NULL OR target.created_at > source.created_at OR ( ( COALESCE(source.metadata_observed_at, 0) >= COALESCE(target.metadata_observed_at, 0) OR (target.subject IS NULL AND source.subject IS NOT NULL) OR (target.description IS NULL AND source.description IS NOT NULL) OR (target.wa_created_at IS NULL AND source.wa_created_at IS NOT NULL) OR (target.announce_only IS NULL AND source.announce_only IS NOT NULL) OR (target.admin_only_edit_info IS NULL AND source.admin_only_edit_info IS NOT NULL) OR (target.member_add_mode IS NULL AND source.member_add_mode IS NOT NULL) OR (target.join_approval_mode IS NULL AND source.join_approval_mode IS NOT NULL) OR (target.ephemeral_duration_seconds IS NULL AND source.ephemeral_duration_seconds IS NOT NULL) ) AND ( (source.subject IS NOT NULL AND NOT (target.subject <=> source.subject)) OR (source.description IS NOT NULL AND NOT (target.description <=> source.description)) OR (source.wa_created_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT (target.wa_created_at <=> source.wa_created_at)) OR (source.announce_only IS NOT NULL AND NOT (target.announce_only <=> source.announce_only)) OR (source.admin_only_edit_info IS NOT NULL AND NOT (target.admin_only_edit_info <=> source.admin_only_edit_info)) OR (source.member_add_mode IS NOT NULL AND NOT (target.member_add_mode <=> source.member_add_mode)) OR (source.join_approval_mode IS NOT NULL AND NOT (target.join_approval_mode <=> source.join_approval_mode)) OR (source.ephemeral_duration_seconds IS NOT NULL AND NOT (target.ephemeral_duration_seconds <=> source.ephemeral_duration_seconds)) ) ) OR ( source.member_count IS NOT NULL AND (target.member_snapshot_at IS NULL OR source.updated_at >= target.member_snapshot_at) AND (source.updated_at >= target.updated_at OR target.member_count IS NULL) AND NOT (target.member_count <=> source.member_count) ) OR ( source.last_checked_at IS NOT NULL AND source.last_checked_at >= COALESCE(target.last_checked_at, 0) AND ( NOT (target.health_status <=> source.health_status) OR NOT (target.banned <=> source.banned) OR NOT (target.checked_member_count <=> source.checked_member_count) OR NOT (target.last_error_code <=> source.last_error_code) OR target.failure_count <> source.failure_count ) ) ORDER BY source.tenant_id ASC, source.group_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE subject = CASE WHEN COALESCE(VALUES(metadata_observed_at), 0) >= COALESCE(wa_group_profile.metadata_observed_at, 0) OR wa_group_profile.subject IS NULL THEN COALESCE(VALUES(subject), wa_group_profile.subject) ELSE wa_group_profile.subject END, description = CASE WHEN COALESCE(VALUES(metadata_observed_at), 0) >= COALESCE(wa_group_profile.metadata_observed_at, 0) OR wa_group_profile.description IS NULL THEN COALESCE(VALUES(description), wa_group_profile.description) ELSE wa_group_profile.description END, wa_created_at = CASE WHEN COALESCE(VALUES(metadata_observed_at), 0) >= COALESCE(wa_group_profile.metadata_observed_at, 0) OR wa_group_profile.wa_created_at IS NULL THEN COALESCE(VALUES(wa_created_at), wa_group_profile.wa_created_at) ELSE wa_group_profile.wa_created_at END, announce_only = CASE WHEN COALESCE(VALUES(metadata_observed_at), 0) >= COALESCE(wa_group_profile.metadata_observed_at, 0) OR wa_group_profile.announce_only IS NULL THEN COALESCE(VALUES(announce_only), wa_group_profile.announce_only) ELSE wa_group_profile.announce_only END, admin_only_edit_info = CASE WHEN COALESCE(VALUES(metadata_observed_at), 0) >= COALESCE(wa_group_profile.metadata_observed_at, 0) OR wa_group_profile.admin_only_edit_info IS NULL THEN COALESCE(VALUES(admin_only_edit_info), wa_group_profile.admin_only_edit_info) ELSE wa_group_profile.admin_only_edit_info END, member_add_mode = CASE WHEN COALESCE(VALUES(metadata_observed_at), 0) >= COALESCE(wa_group_profile.metadata_observed_at, 0) OR wa_group_profile.member_add_mode IS NULL THEN COALESCE(VALUES(member_add_mode), wa_group_profile.member_add_mode) ELSE wa_group_profile.member_add_mode END, join_approval_mode = CASE WHEN COALESCE(VALUES(metadata_observed_at), 0) >= COALESCE(wa_group_profile.metadata_observed_at, 0) OR wa_group_profile.join_approval_mode IS NULL THEN COALESCE(VALUES(join_approval_mode), wa_group_profile.join_approval_mode) ELSE wa_group_profile.join_approval_mode END, ephemeral_duration_seconds = CASE WHEN COALESCE(VALUES(metadata_observed_at), 0) >= COALESCE(wa_group_profile.metadata_observed_at, 0) OR wa_group_profile.ephemeral_duration_seconds IS NULL THEN COALESCE( VALUES(ephemeral_duration_seconds), wa_group_profile.ephemeral_duration_seconds ) ELSE wa_group_profile.ephemeral_duration_seconds END, member_count = CASE WHEN ( wa_group_profile.member_snapshot_at IS NULL OR VALUES(updated_at) >= wa_group_profile.member_snapshot_at ) AND ( VALUES(updated_at) >= wa_group_profile.updated_at OR wa_group_profile.member_count IS NULL ) THEN COALESCE(VALUES(member_count), wa_group_profile.member_count) ELSE wa_group_profile.member_count END, checked_member_count = CASE WHEN VALUES(last_checked_at) >= COALESCE(wa_group_profile.last_checked_at, 0) THEN COALESCE( VALUES(checked_member_count), wa_group_profile.checked_member_count ) ELSE wa_group_profile.checked_member_count END, metadata_observed_at = CASE WHEN VALUES(metadata_observed_at) IS NULL THEN wa_group_profile.metadata_observed_at WHEN wa_group_profile.metadata_observed_at IS NULL THEN VALUES(metadata_observed_at) ELSE GREATEST( wa_group_profile.metadata_observed_at, VALUES(metadata_observed_at) ) END, health_status = CASE WHEN VALUES(last_checked_at) >= COALESCE(wa_group_profile.last_checked_at, 0) THEN VALUES(health_status) ELSE wa_group_profile.health_status END, banned = CASE WHEN VALUES(last_checked_at) >= COALESCE(wa_group_profile.last_checked_at, 0) THEN VALUES(banned) ELSE wa_group_profile.banned END, last_error_code = CASE WHEN VALUES(last_checked_at) >= COALESCE(wa_group_profile.last_checked_at, 0) THEN VALUES(last_error_code) ELSE wa_group_profile.last_error_code END, failure_count = CASE WHEN VALUES(last_checked_at) >= COALESCE(wa_group_profile.last_checked_at, 0) THEN VALUES(failure_count) ELSE wa_group_profile.failure_count END, last_checked_at = CASE WHEN VALUES(last_checked_at) IS NULL THEN wa_group_profile.last_checked_at WHEN wa_group_profile.last_checked_at IS NULL THEN VALUES(last_checked_at) ELSE GREATEST(wa_group_profile.last_checked_at, VALUES(last_checked_at)) END, created_at = LEAST(wa_group_profile.created_at, VALUES(created_at)), updated_at = GREATEST(wa_group_profile.updated_at, VALUES(updated_at))

INSERT INTO wa_group_profile ( tenant_id, group_id, member_count, member_snapshot_at, member_snapshot_version, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT cache.tenant_id, resolved_group.id, SUM(CASE WHEN state.snapshot_version = cache.snapshot_version AND state.is_in_group = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS member_count, cache.snapshot_at AS member_snapshot_at, cache.snapshot_version AS member_snapshot_version, cache.created_at, cache.updated_at FROM whatsapp_group_member_cache cache INNER JOIN wa_group resolved_group ON resolved_group.tenant_id = cache.tenant_id AND resolved_group.group_jid = LOWER(TRIM(cache.group_jid)) LEFT JOIN whatsapp_group_member_state state ON state.tenant_id = cache.tenant_id AND LOWER(TRIM(state.group_jid)) = resolved_group.group_jid LEFT JOIN wa_group_profile target ON target.tenant_id = cache.tenant_id AND target.group_id = resolved_group.id WHERE target.id IS NULL OR cache.snapshot_at > COALESCE(target.member_snapshot_at, -1) OR ( cache.snapshot_at = target.member_snapshot_at AND CAST(cache.snapshot_version AS BINARY) > CAST(COALESCE(target.member_snapshot_version, '') AS BINARY) ) GROUP BY cache.tenant_id, resolved_group.id, cache.snapshot_at, cache.snapshot_version, cache.created_at, cache.updated_at ORDER BY cache.tenant_id ASC, resolved_group.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE member_count = CASE WHEN VALUES(member_snapshot_at) > COALESCE(wa_group_profile.member_snapshot_at, -1) OR ( VALUES(member_snapshot_at) = wa_group_profile.member_snapshot_at AND CAST(VALUES(member_snapshot_version) AS BINARY) > CAST(COALESCE(wa_group_profile.member_snapshot_version, '') AS BINARY) ) THEN VALUES(member_count) ELSE wa_group_profile.member_count END, member_snapshot_version = CASE WHEN VALUES(member_snapshot_at) > COALESCE(wa_group_profile.member_snapshot_at, -1) OR ( VALUES(member_snapshot_at) = wa_group_profile.member_snapshot_at AND CAST(VALUES(member_snapshot_version) AS BINARY) > CAST(COALESCE(wa_group_profile.member_snapshot_version, '') AS BINARY) ) THEN VALUES(member_snapshot_version) ELSE wa_group_profile.member_snapshot_version END, member_snapshot_at = CASE WHEN wa_group_profile.member_snapshot_at IS NULL THEN VALUES(member_snapshot_at) ELSE GREATEST(wa_group_profile.member_snapshot_at, VALUES(member_snapshot_at)) END, created_at = LEAST(wa_group_profile.created_at, VALUES(created_at)), updated_at = GREATEST(wa_group_profile.updated_at, VALUES(updated_at))

INSERT INTO wa_group_invite ( tenant_id, group_id, invite_code, label_id, display_name, avatar_url, remark, origin, preview_subject, preview_observed_at, health_status, banned, checked_member_count, last_checked_at, last_error_code, failure_count, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at ) SELECT source.tenant_id, source.group_id, source.invite_code, source.label_id, source.display_name, source.avatar_url, source.remark, source.origin, source.preview_subject, source.preview_observed_at, source.health_status, source.banned, source.checked_member_count, source.last_checked_at, source.last_error_code, source.failure_count, source.created_at, source.updated_at, NULL FROM ( SELECT preview.tenant_id, resolved_group.id AS group_id, TRIM(preview.invite_code) AS invite_code, link.label_id, CASE WHEN resolved_group.id IS NULL THEN NULLIF(TRIM(link.group_name), '') ELSE NULL END AS display_name, CASE WHEN resolved_group.id IS NULL THEN NULLIF(TRIM(preview.avatar_url), '') ELSE NULL END AS avatar_url, CASE WHEN resolved_group.id IS NULL THEN link.remark ELSE NULL END AS remark, link.origin, CASE WHEN resolved_group.id IS NULL THEN NULLIF(TRIM(preview.wa_subject), '') ELSE NULL END AS preview_subject, CASE WHEN resolved_group.id IS NULL THEN preview.last_preview_at ELSE NULL END AS preview_observed_at, CASE WHEN resolved_group.id IS NULL THEN health.health_status ELSE NULL END AS health_status, CASE WHEN resolved_group.id IS NULL THEN health.is_banned ELSE NULL END AS banned, CASE WHEN resolved_group.id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(health.current_count, preview.member_size) ELSE NULL END AS checked_member_count, CASE WHEN resolved_group.id IS NULL THEN health.last_check_at ELSE NULL END AS last_checked_at, CASE WHEN resolved_group.id IS NULL THEN LEFT(health.last_health_error, 64) ELSE NULL END AS last_error_code, CASE WHEN resolved_group.id IS NULL THEN COALESCE(health.health_failure_count, 0) ELSE 0 END AS failure_count, LEAST(link.created_at, preview.created_at) AS created_at, GREATEST( link.updated_at, preview.updated_at, COALESCE(health.updated_at, preview.updated_at) ) AS updated_at FROM group_link_preview preview INNER JOIN group_link link ON preview.tenant_id = link.tenant_id AND preview.group_link_id = link.id LEFT JOIN wa_group resolved_group ON resolved_group.tenant_id = preview.tenant_id AND resolved_group.group_jid = LOWER(TRIM(preview.group_jid)) LEFT JOIN group_link_health health ON health.tenant_id = preview.tenant_id AND health.group_link_id = preview.group_link_id WHERE preview.invite_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(preview.invite_code) <> '' ) source LEFT JOIN wa_group_invite target ON target.tenant_id = source.tenant_id AND target.invite_code = source.invite_code WHERE target.id IS NULL OR (target.group_id IS NULL AND source.group_id IS NOT NULL) OR target.created_at > source.created_at OR ( ( source.updated_at >= target.updated_at OR target.label_id IS NULL OR target.display_name IS NULL OR target.avatar_url IS NULL OR target.remark IS NULL ) AND ( (source.label_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT (target.label_id <=> source.label_id)) OR (source.display_name IS NOT NULL AND NOT (target.display_name <=> source.display_name)) OR (source.avatar_url IS NOT NULL AND NOT (target.avatar_url <=> source.avatar_url)) OR (source.remark IS NOT NULL AND NOT (target.remark <=> source.remark)) ) ) OR ( source.preview_observed_at IS NOT NULL AND source.preview_observed_at >= COALESCE(target.preview_observed_at, 0) AND source.preview_subject IS NOT NULL AND NOT (target.preview_subject <=> source.preview_subject) ) OR ( source.last_checked_at IS NOT NULL AND source.last_checked_at >= COALESCE(target.last_checked_at, 0) AND ( NOT (target.health_status <=> source.health_status) OR NOT (target.banned <=> source.banned) OR (source.checked_member_count IS NOT NULL AND NOT (target.checked_member_count <=> source.checked_member_count)) OR NOT (target.last_error_code <=> source.last_error_code) OR target.failure_count <> source.failure_count ) ) ORDER BY source.tenant_id ASC, source.invite_code ASC LIMIT #{limit} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE group_id = COALESCE(wa_group_invite.group_id, VALUES(group_id)), label_id = CASE WHEN VALUES(updated_at) >= wa_group_invite.updated_at OR VALUES(created_at) < wa_group_invite.created_at OR (source.lid_jid IS NOT NULL AND target.lid_jid = source.lid_jid) ) WHERE target.id IS NULL OR target.created_at > source.created_at OR (target.phone IS NULL AND source.phone IS NOT NULL) OR CAST(COALESCE(target.last_join_source_event_id, '') AS BINARY) ) ORDER BY source.tenant_id ASC, source.group_id ASC, COALESCE(source.pn_jid, source.lid_jid) ASC LIMIT #{limit} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE VALUES(last_join_event_at) = wa_group_participant.last_join_event_at AND CAST(VALUES(last_join_source_event_id) AS BINARY) > CAST(COALESCE( wa_group_participant.last_join_source_event_id, '' ) AS INSERT INTO wa_account_group_binding ( tenant_id, account_id, group_id, participant_id, was_in_initial_baseline, baseline_subject_snapshot, membership_active_since_at, last_observed_at, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT source.tenant_id, source.account_id, source.group_id, participant.id, source.was_in_initial_baseline, source.baseline_subject_snapshot, source.membership_active_since_at, source.last_observed_at, source.created_at, source.updated_at FROM ( SELECT membership.tenant_id, membership.account_id, resolved_group.id AS group_id, CONCAT(TRIM(account.ws_phone), '@s.whatsapp.net') AS pn_jid, CASE WHEN account.group_baseline_state = 2 AND baseline.id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE( baseline.baseline_group_jids, '$[*]' COLUMNS (group_jid VARCHAR(128) PATH '$') ) baseline_match WHERE LOWER(TRIM(baseline_match.group_jid)) = LOWER(TRIM(membership.group_jid)) ) THEN 1 ELSE NULL END AS was_in_initial_baseline, CASE WHEN account.group_baseline_state = 2 AND baseline.id IS NOT NULL AND baseline.baseline_group_subjects IS NOT NULL THEN NULLIF(TRIM(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT( baseline.baseline_group_subjects, CONCAT( '$."', REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(membership.group_jid)), '"', '\\"'), '"' ) ))), '') ELSE NULL END AS baseline_subject_snapshot, membership.joined_at AS membership_active_since_at, COALESCE( membership.last_seen_at, membership.status_updated_at, membership.updated_at ) AS last_observed_at, membership.created_at, membership.updated_at FROM account_group_membership membership INNER JOIN account account ON account.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND account.id = membership.account_id AND account.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN wa_group resolved_group ON resolved_group.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND resolved_group.group_jid = LOWER(TRIM(membership.group_jid)) LEFT JOIN account_group_baseline baseline ON baseline.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND baseline.account_id = account.id WHERE membership.deleted_at IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT account.tenant_id, account.id AS account_id, resolved_group.id AS group_id, CONCAT(TRIM(account.ws_phone), '@s.whatsapp.net') AS pn_jid, 1 AS was_in_initial_baseline, CASE WHEN baseline.baseline_group_subjects IS NOT NULL THEN NULLIF(TRIM(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT( baseline.baseline_group_subjects, CONCAT( '$."', REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(baseline_group.group_jid)), '"', '\\"'), '"' ) ))), '') ELSE NULL END AS baseline_subject_snapshot, NULL AS membership_active_since_at, baseline.captured_at AS last_observed_at, LEAST(account.created_at, baseline.created_at) AS created_at, GREATEST(account.updated_at, baseline.updated_at) AS updated_at FROM account account INNER JOIN account_group_baseline baseline ON baseline.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND baseline.account_id = account.id INNER JOIN JSON_TABLE( baseline.baseline_group_jids, '$[*]' COLUMNS (group_jid VARCHAR(128) PATH '$') ) baseline_group INNER JOIN wa_group resolved_group ON resolved_group.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND resolved_group.group_jid = LOWER(TRIM(baseline_group.group_jid)) LEFT JOIN account_group_membership membership ON membership.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND membership.account_id = account.id AND LOWER(TRIM(membership.group_jid)) = LOWER(TRIM(baseline_group.group_jid)) AND membership.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE account.deleted_at IS NULL AND account.group_baseline_state = 2 AND membership.id IS NULL ) source INNER JOIN wa_group_participant participant ON participant.tenant_id = source.tenant_id AND participant.group_id = source.group_id AND participant.pn_jid = source.pn_jid LEFT JOIN wa_account_group_binding target ON target.tenant_id = source.tenant_id AND target.account_id = source.account_id AND target.group_id = source.group_id WHERE target.id IS NULL OR target.created_at > source.created_at OR ( source.last_observed_at > COALESCE(target.last_observed_at, -1) AND target.participant_id <> participant.id ) OR (target.was_in_initial_baseline IS NULL AND source.was_in_initial_baseline = 1) OR (target.baseline_subject_snapshot IS NULL AND source.baseline_subject_snapshot IS NOT NULL) OR (target.membership_active_since_at IS NULL AND source.membership_active_since_at IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY source.tenant_id ASC, source.account_id ASC, source.group_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE participant_id = CASE WHEN VALUES(last_observed_at) > COALESCE(wa_account_group_binding.last_observed_at, -1) THEN VALUES(participant_id) ELSE wa_account_group_binding.participant_id END, was_in_initial_baseline = COALESCE( wa_account_group_binding.was_in_initial_baseline, VALUES(was_in_initial_baseline) ), baseline_subject_snapshot = COALESCE( wa_account_group_binding.baseline_subject_snapshot, VALUES(baseline_subject_snapshot) ), membership_active_since_at = COALESCE( wa_account_group_binding.membership_active_since_at, VALUES(membership_active_since_at) ), last_observed_at = CASE WHEN wa_account_group_binding.last_observed_at IS NULL THEN VALUES(last_observed_at) ELSE GREATEST( wa_account_group_binding.last_observed_at, VALUES(last_observed_at) ) END, created_at = LEAST(wa_account_group_binding.created_at, VALUES(created_at)), updated_at = GREATEST(wa_account_group_binding.updated_at, VALUES(updated_at))

GREATEST(account.updated_at, baseline.updated_at) END AS updated_at FROM account account LEFT JOIN account_group_baseline baseline ON baseline.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND baseline.account_id = account.id WHERE account.deleted_at IS NULL ) source LEFT JOIN account_group_sync_state target ON target.tenant_id = source.tenant_id AND target.account_id = source.account_id WHERE target.id IS NULL OR target.created_at > source.created_at OR ( source.last_sync_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND source.last_sync_requested_at > COALESCE(target.last_sync_requested_at, -1) ) OR ( account_group_sync_state.baseline_completeness = 0 AND VALUES(baseline_completeness) = 2 THEN VALUES(baseline_state) ELSE account_group_sync_state.baseline_state END, baseline_captured_at = CASE WHEN = CASE WHEN account_group_sync_state.baseline_completeness = 0 AND VALUES(baseline_completeness) = 2 THEN VALUES(baseline_group_count) ELSE account_group_sync_state.baseline_group_count END, baseline_completeness = CASE WHEN account_group_sync_state.baseline_completeness = 0 AND VALUES(baseline_completeness) = 2 THEN 2 ELSE account_group_sync_state.baseline_completeness END, last_sync_requested_at = CASE WHEN VALUES(last_sync_requested_at) IS NULL THEN account_group_sync_state.last_sync_requested_at WHEN account_group_sync_state.last_sync_requested_at IS NULL THEN VALUES(last_sync_requested_at) ELSE GREATEST( account_group_sync_state.last_sync_requested_at, VALUES(last_sync_requested_at) ) END, created_at = LEAST(account_group_sync_state.created_at,
